notes.title: Now you can choose the difficulty level!
notes.content:
The choice of difficulty does not affect the damage inflicted or received and the number of opponents, as it would be too banal. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085504/f5d87a68fa0eb26d14443634425101794eb60487.png[/img]

From now on, before the start of a new run, the following game modes are available to you:

EASY MODE
[list]
[*] More nanoparticles for killed enemies.
[*] Implants do not damaged.
[*] You can take up to five extra lives.
[*] An extra life completely restores health.
[*] Medical terminals restore up to five health points.
[/list]

CLASSIC
[list]
[*] Implant damaged if an extra life is spent.
[*] You can take up to three extra lives.
[*] An extra life restores only part of your health.
[*] Medical terminals restore up to three health points.
[/list]

CHALLENGE
[list]
[*] The chance of damage to the implant when taking damage.
[*] You can only take one extra life.
[*] An extra life restores only part of your health.
[*] Medical terminals restore up to two health points.
[*] Ability is not restored if you do not have batteries.
[/list]

[h3]I am also glad to announce that the demo version of Iron Dungeon is coming out very soon![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2083910/Iron_Dungeon/

notes.title: Try the new game mode
notes.content:
[h3]This update offers you to fight in ten consecutive arenas with a large number of enemies.
There are no shelters here, so you will have to rely only on your weapons, implants and your reaction![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085504/4dd9fb5227be6ce96b926cb4fc6888c87a32b4c3.png[/img]

Please note that this mode is only available to experienced fighters, so to open access to it, you will first need to defeat the second boss at least once in the main game.

- Several bugs have also been fixed.
- Increased the hitbox of missiles launched by the player.
- Improved font.


[h3]In addition, I started working on a new game.
If you are interested, you can add it to your wish list and subscribe for updates! Details will be a little later.[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2083910/Iron_Dungeon/

[b]Even though I've started working on a new game, I'm still planning to release updates for REPLIKATOR![/b]

notes.title: Version 1.0 is available!
notes.content:
Hello, friends!
I am glad to announce that version 1.0 is now available!
This means that the main work is finished and the REPLIKATOR has finally reached a full release.
For nine months in early access, the game has undergone significant changes and has become better thanks to everyone who shared feedback with me!

Some changes in the v. 1.0 update:
- Added secret rooms (look for special buttons on the walls).
- New challenge arenas. (you can get there through a portal that opens under certain conditions)
- Добавлена система дополнительных наград за прохождение уровней.
- The balance has been heavily redesigned.
- Added the final boss.
- The maximum number of implants has been increased to 15.
- Now, after activation of replication, there is a possibility of failure of the implant when receiving damage.
- During boss battles, the implant can also be damaged.
- Redesigned some implants and weapons, including VCG10000.
- Fixed a large number of bugs.
- Small visual improvements.
- Many other changes and improvements.
- Localization into Spanish. In the future, I hope to add other localizations.

The work continues.
I plan to release new updates in the future, including bug fixes, game balance improvements, and possibly adding new content.

notes.title: Update v. 0.978
notes.content:
I think some of you have noticed that no new updates have been released recently. The fact is that working on the game takes a lot of time and effort, so I took a little vacation.
Now that I've had some rest, I'm going back to developing.

This small update mainly includes bug fixes and performance improvements on weak computers.

- Fixed incorrect display of markers on the map.
- Now, when you run the game on a laptop, a discrete video adapter is selected. (IAnyway I hope so)*
- Performance optimization.
- Buying a level map now requires one battery instead of two.


*If the game slows down on a laptop with a discrete video card, then you need to go to the video card settings and manually set the game to start using a discrete video adapter.
(Nvidia Control Panel or Catalyst Control Center)

notes.title: Update v. 0.977
notes.content:
UPD!
Now the implants fail only when you lose an extra life (1UP).
The cost of an extra life is slightly reduced. 
Now you can buy up to three 1UP, or find up to five 1UP at stations.

[strike]Now, when you take damage, one of your implants may fail.[/strike]

FAULTY implants have negative consequences, as a rule - the opposite of the positive effect of SERVICEABLE implants.

On the ship you will find a workbench where you can repair all the implants.

Among other changes:
- Fixed minor bugs.
- Small graphic changes.
- Small changes in the balance.

- you can now reassign the control keys (including the gamepad)
- the crosshair is no longer hidden when playing with a gamepad.
- destructible objects have become more fragile for melee attacks
- bug fixes
